abilities.name: harvest
abilities.effect: Has a 50% chance of restoring a used Berry after each turn if the Pokémon has held no items in the meantime.

kanto.flavorText: It is often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

original-johto.flavorText: If even one is separated from the group, the energy bond between the six will make them rejoin instantly.

hoenn.flavorText: It consists of six eggs that care for each other. The eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear, it is close to evolution.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

updated-johto.flavorText: Using telepathy only they can employ, they always form a cluster of six EXEGGCUTE.

original-unova.flavorText: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

updated-unova.flavorText: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

kalos.flavorText: Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort, it was discovered to be a life-form more like plant seeds.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: This Pokémon consists of six eggs that form a closely knit cluster. The six eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear on the eggs, Exeggcute is close to evolution.

original-alola.flavorText: Six of them together form a full-fledged Pokémon. It’s often hunted by Crabrawler, but uses psychokinesis to drive it off.

updated-alola.flavorText: Although they are the same size as other Exeggcute, the ones produced in Alola are quite heavy. Their shells are packed full.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: The heads attract each other and spin around. There must be six heads for it to maintain balance.

swsh.flavorText: These Pokémon get nervous when they’re not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

freeTextEntries: Savanna Biome, Coastal Biome, Torchlit Labyrinth | Tera Raid Battles (1★ Exeggcute)
